alt: 棋盤上的國王被對方棋子從四面包圍，沒有援手，也找不到能安全移動的位置。
scene_prompt: 四面楚歌 means being surrounded by difficulty on all sides, isolated with no help or way out. Modern chess club, board dominates foreground. A single PALE KING is trapped at the center by DARK opponent pieces on ALL FOUR sides; pale supporting pieces have been captured and lie far off the board, leaving the king isolated. The pale-side player looks anxiously for an escape and finds none, while other players around the small table watch silently. The focus is enclosing isolation, not a completed celebration of victory. No fallen king, combat, injury, readable notation, words, labels or numbers. Fictional illustrative position need not be a formal puzzle, but the all-around encirclement must be unmistakable.
